verdict.rationale: Muse is documented only as a personal AI agent. Its controls are individual: approving actions, choosing which apps the agent can access, viewing the activity log and approved permissions, and a personal training opt-out switch. There is no evidence of an organization workspace, member management, role-based permissions or admin-set data policies, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace
